name: Squall
description: Odessa's pills laid on their side: capsules running one, two or three cells across, stacking into gusts.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { height: 62%; margin-top: 19%; width: @pick(100%, 200%, 300%); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 999px; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
